{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYfcQKQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCDs3w", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 3, "title": "Document and fixture the 1996–1997 PC-VAN text-service evidence", "body": "## Problem

A generic retro BBS UI would misrepresent PC-VAN. The repository currently has no historical behavior specification or provenance-tagged source data. An implementer must be able to tell observed 1996-era behavior from reconstruction.

## Expected outcome

Commit a concise, source-grounded reference and machine-readable fixtures that later implementation Issues can consume without inventing historical menus or copying user archives.

## Context

Target **the text-terminal PC-VAN experience around 1996–1997**, not the later Windows graphical navigator. The 1996 MAIN transcription must not be merged with a different undated NEC screenshot, or asserted to be unchanged throughout 1997.

Reference sources (each should be assessed for date, scope and reliability):
- [1996-era MAIN transcription and 1992-era contrast](https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm) — retrospective transcription, **not** an original screen capture. 1996 has 21 numbered entries and X/Q.
- [1996-07-06 PC-VAN ECOM session transcript](https://elestamp.o.oo7.jp/Computer_history.htm) — contemporaneous preserved text in the page; shows `番号またはコマンド(H,Q,E,J)=` and a **service-specific** article-list prompt with `RBn, TLn, KW` etc. Do **not** generalize ECOM shortcuts to SIG forums.
- [Former DAISIZEN SIG operator's archive](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/index.htm) — SIG section names and seven numbered forums. Its section ordering is **not** a complete terminal-menu dump.
- [1996-era user's `J MITI > 3 > 9` route](https://www.asyura2.com/profile.htm) — a direct SIG jump, forum then 資料室 route.
- [Historical forum archive](https://www.rumic.org/forum/) — period post header structures, numbers, dates, reply conventions; observe structure only, do **not** bulk-copy posts or identities.
- [NEC retrospective PC-VAN screen](https://support.nec-lavie.jp/navigate/application/prevent/useful/20201215/index02.html) — different/undated MAIN variant; keep separate.

Historical evidence categories: A contemporary logs; B firsthand operator/user documentation; C retrospective reproductions; D implementation assumptions. Exact years/attribution should be recorded rather than treating levels as proof of authenticity.

Scope is research documentation and fixtures only; do not create the application in this Issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add `docs/research/pcvan-1996-1997.md` with a source URL, observed detail, date/era, evidence category, confidence/limitation and reproduction implication for each reference, including explicitly unresolved 1997 menu version, SIG intermediate menus, compose prompts, and keyboard shortcuts.
- [ ] Add parseable UTF-8 machine-readable fixtures in `data/pcvan/` for **1996 MAIN (21 entries plus X and Q)** and the evidence-backed DAISIZEN forums and MITI path; attach source URLs and explicit `verified`/`reconstructed`/`provisional` status to each uncertain item.
- [ ] Record that the DAISIZEN SIG jump keyword is **unverified** (do not quietly assume `J DAISIZEN` is historical), whereas `J MITI` followed by `3` and `9` has firsthand route evidence.
- [ ] Explicitly separate the ECOM `RBn/TLn/KW/...` prompt from SIG forum commands; do not assign meanings without evidence.
- [ ] Include an example of the observed post-header fields (`#number/secondary`, `★タイトル`, PC-VAN ID/date/line count, `★内容`) with synthetic placeholder content, and mark the meaning of the secondary number and historical line count as unknown.
- [ ] Do not copy full archived user posts, real people's identities or copyrighted screenshots into source control; use citations/links and original demonstration text.
- [ ] Validate JSON parsing, fixture item uniqueness and source URLs, and check documentation/fixture consistency; no unrelated runtime tooling or application code.

## Optional validation

None proposed.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.
